scope:
Bounded, same-reader evidence-condition diagnostic on exposed paper QA.

This replays source views through the production model gateway and context
policy. It is not a new retrieval algorithm, AgentRun or formal Experiment.
quality_scope: Source-reviewed development diagnostic, not a new method comparison or human-expert semantic accuracy score.
scoring: All frozen rows retained; invalid/failed/missing = zero, never successful refusal. Official max-reference EM/F1 unchanged. Constructed negatives and natural controls separate.
stop_rules: Stop further dispatch after any fallback, unknown transport, model identity mismatch, or non-400 provider failure.
Stop at three known HTTP400 rejections; keep all planned denominators. No retries or continuation.
Formatting failures remain zero; do not change prompt or schema after inspecting answers.
acceptance: Diagnostic completion and valid source contrasts only; no production promotion from this experiment.
review_limit: Machine-assisted source review is not human-expert calibration. Sufficiency disputes excluded before requests and retained in full ledger.

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
